paragraphs.text: Sit down and get into a comfortable position. Your legs are angled with your feet on the floor. Put your hands on your thighs. Your palms can be up or down. Close your eyes and move your attention to your breathing. Breathe in relaxation and breathe out tension. Each time you breathe out, let more and more tension leave your body.
Now focus on your lower jaw and relax it. Feel your face, relax and soften. You are calm and relaxed. Your breathing is calm and even.

Move your attention to your right hand and forearm. Now clench your fist, tighten your fist so that you can feel the tension of your muscles in your hand and forearm. The next time you breathe out, release all that tension and relax. Feel the relaxation and notice the difference from before. Each time you breathe out, relax deeper.

Now bring your attention to your right upper arm. Press your right hand against your thigh. Feel the tension in your triceps and biceps. The next time you breathe out, release all that tension and relax. Feel the relaxation and notice the difference from before. Each time you breathe out, relax deeper.

Move your attention to your left hand and forearm. Clench your fist, tighten your fist so that you can feel the tension of your muscles in your hand and forearm. The next time you breathe out, release all that tension and relax. Feel the relaxation and notice the difference from before. Each time you breathe out, relax deeper.

Bring your attention to your left upper arm. Now press your left hand against your thigh. Feel the tension in your triceps and biceps. The next time you breathe out, release all that tension and relax. Feel the relaxation and notice the difference from before. Each time you breathe out, relax deeper.

Move your attention to your face. Focus on your forehead. Tighten the muscles in your forehead by raising your eyebrows as high as you can. Feel the tension of your forehead. Now release and relax. Now pull the eyebrows together. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper.
Bring your attention to your upper cheeks, nose and eyes. Now close your eyes tightly and wrinkle your nose. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper.

Bring your attention to your cheeks and jaw. Now clench your teeth and pull back the corners of your mouth. Now release and relax. Purse your lips together. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper.

Focus on your neck. Fold your hands and put them on the back of your head. Now press your head against your hands. Feel the tension in your neck. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper.

Direct your attention now to your shoulders, upper back and chest. Now pull your shoulders back so that your shoulder blades approach one another. Feel the tension. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper.

Direct your attention to your abdomen. Now tighten your abdomen muscles as if you had to defend a punch. Feel the tension. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper.

Direct your attention to your buttocks and pelvic floor. Now tighten your buttocks by pulling them together. Feel the tension. Release and relax. Notice the difference from before. While breathing out, relax deeper and deeper.

Move your attention to your right leg. Focus on your thigh. Now stretch your leg so that your leg is nearly parallel to the ground. Pull your toes towards you and feel the tension of your thigh muscles. Release and relax. Bring your leg back to the starting position. Feel the difference. As you breathe out, relax deeper. Let go of the tension.

Focus on your right lower leg and foot. Curl your toes towards you. Feel the tension in your calf muscles. Release and relax. Feel the difference. As you breathe out, relax deeper. Let go. Let go of the tension.
Keep your focus on the right foot. Now curl your toes as if you want to grab something. Feel the tension in your foot. Release and relax. Feel the difference. As you breathe out, relax deeper.

Move your attention to your left leg. Focus on your thigh. Now stretch your leg so that your leg is nearly straight to the ground. Pull your toes towards you and feel the tension of your thigh muscles. Release and relax. Bring your leg back into the starting position with the foot on the ground. Feel the difference. As you breathe out, relax deeper.
Focus on your left lower leg and foot. Curl your toes towards you. Feel the tension in your calf muscles. Release and relax. Feel the difference. As you breathe out, relax deeper.
Keep your focus on the left foot. Curl your toes as if you want to grab something. Feel the tension in your foot. Release and relax. Feel the difference. As you breathe out, relax deeper.
Now move mentally through your muscles starting from your face all the way down to your feet and relax deeper and deeper. You are feeling calm and relaxed.
